Principles of Marketing

    Marketing, and why anticipation is the core · Marketing vs selling · Textbook: Marketing: Creating Customer Value and Engagement

  4. The marketing environment & exchange system

    The marketing environment · Exchange, transaction, relationship · Textbook: Marketing: Creating Customer Value and Engagement · Textbook: Analyzing the Marketing Environment

  6. Segmentation

    Why segment at all · The five bases of segmentation · Textbook: Company and Marketing Strategy: Partnering to Build Customer Engagement, Value, and Relationships · Textbook: Customer Value-Driven Marketing Strategy: Creating Value for Target Customers

  7. Targeting

    Targeting and the SAFE framework · Textbook: Customer Value-Driven Marketing Strategy: Creating Value for Target Customers

    Positioning and the frame of reference · POPs and PODs · Textbook: Customer Value-Driven Marketing Strategy: Creating Value for Target Customers

  9. Consumer behaviour

    Why people buy, and the three eras · Story over product · Heuristics at the point of purchase · Buying stages in practice: sets, scores and shortcuts · What consumer behaviour studies · The five stages, and where the decision is won · When buyers skip, reverse and loop · The messy middle: exploring and evaluating in a loop · Marketing works at every stage, not just the till · The integrated consumer behaviour framework · Three theories of motivation: why the journey begins · Freud: the iceberg, id, ego and superego · Maslow: the lowest unmet need drives behaviour · Herzberg: hygiene factors and motivators · Textbook: Consumer Markets and Buyer Behavior
